newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers 200 MW firm, peak power for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers 200 MW firm, peak power for Wed.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 200 megawatts of firm peak power on Wednesday at $11.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest and $12.00 for Oregon border sales, BPA said Tuesday.
BPA had offered no power during peak demand hours on Tuesday and continued to refrain from offering non-firm power during morning and evening peaks on Wednesday.
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
Non-firm shoulder hour (0600-0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2300) offers were also steady at $10.00 for Northwest and $11.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) and Nevada-Oregon border (NOB) sales.
BPA also offered displacement power during off-peak hours on Wednesday at $7.00 per MWh for all deliveries and at $5.00 for Northwest buyers only.
